questions.question: An employee contributes 20% of their salary to charity. From the remaining amount, 40% is allocated to investments. The rest is divided for education and travel in the ratio 7: 5. If the expense on travel is ₹6000, what is the employee's total salary?
questions.questionHtml: An employee contributes 20% of their salary to charity. From the remaining amount, 40% is allocated to investments. The rest is divided for education and travel in the ratio 7: 5. If the expense on travel is ₹6000, what is the employee's total salary?
questions.solution:
Let total salary = 100x

⇒ After charity = 100x × 80 ÷ 100 = 80x

⇒ Remaining after investment = 80x × 60 ÷ 100 = 48x

⇒ Travel share = (5 ÷ (7 + 5)) × 48x = (5 ÷ 12) × 48x = 20x

⇒ 20x = 6000 ⇒ x = 6000 ÷ 20 = 300

⇒ Total salary = 100x = 100 × 300 = 30000

questions.question: A certain amount increases to five times its initial value after 10 years of compounding interest. How many years will it take for it to grow to twenty-five times its original amount?

questions.solution:
5P = P × (1 + r)10

5 = (1 + r)10

25 = 52 = ((1 + r)10)2 = (1 + r)20

25P = P × (1 + r)20

Required time = 20 years

questions.question: The speeds of two motorcyclists are in the ratio 5 : 3. If the slower motorcyclist has a 24 km head start, and his speed is 12 km/h, how far (in km) will the faster motorcyclist travel to overtake him?
questions.questionHtml: The speeds of two motorcyclists are in the ratio 5 : 3. If the slower motorcyclist has a 24 km head start, and his speed is 12 km/h, how far (in km) will the faster motorcyclist travel to overtake him?
questions.solution:
⇒ 3k = 12 ⇒ k = 4

⇒ Faster speed = 5 × 4 = 20 km/h

⇒ Relative speed = 20 − 12 = 8 km/h

⇒ Time to overtake = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 hours

⇒ Distance travelled by faster = 20 × 3 = 60 km

questions.solution:
sin θ = cos θ

⇒ tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ = 1

⇒ θ = 45° (as tan 45° = 1)

questions.question: The base area of a prism is increased by 25%, while the height remains the same. By what percentage does the volume increase?
questions.questionHtml: The base area of a prism is increased by 25%, while the height remains the same. By what percentage does the volume increase?
questions.solution:
Let original base area = 100, new base area = 125, height = h.

Original volume = 100 × h, new volume = 125 × h.

Increase in volume = 125h − 100h = 25h, percentage increase = (25h ÷ 100h) × 100 = 25%.

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 2:3:5. If their average is 100, what is the difference between the largest and the smallest number?
questions.questionHtml: Three numbers are in the ratio 2:3:5. If their average is 100, what is the difference between the largest and the smallest number?
questions.solution:
Let numbers = 2k, 3k, 5k

⇒ Sum = 2k + 3k + 5k = 10k

⇒ Average = Sum ÷ 3 ⇒ 100 = 10k ÷ 3

⇒ 10k = 300 ⇒ k = 30

⇒ Smallest number = 2 × 30 = 60

⇒ Largest number = 5 × 30 = 150

⇒ Difference = 150 − 60 = 90

<svg width="500" height="280" viewBox="0 0 500 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#555555"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Alligation & Mixture Mechanism -->
  <!-- Can A -->
  <path d="M 40 50 L 40 90 A 20 5 0 0 0 80 90 L 80 50" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="50" rx="20" ry="5" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="45" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">40L</text>
  <text x="35" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">₹50/L</text>

  <!-- Can B -->
  <path d="M 280 40 L 280 90 A 20 5 0 0 0 320 90 L 320 40" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="40" rx="20" ry="5" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="285" y="30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6a1b9a">60L</text>
  <text x="275" y="70" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6a1b9a">₹60/L</text>

  <!-- Alligation Cross -->
  <line x1="80" y1="90" x2="280" y2="150" stroke="#888888" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  <line x1="280" y1="90" x2="80" y2="150" stroke="#888888" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  
  <!-- Mean CP Circle -->
  <circle cx="180" cy="120" r="25" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="165" y="125" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#222222">56</text>
  <text x="160" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="11" fill="#555555">Mean CP</text>

  <!-- Ratios at bottom -->
  <text x="65" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">4 parts</text>
  <text x="285" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">6 parts</text>
  <text x="160" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">(Ratio 2 : 3)</text>

  <!-- Sale visualization -->
  <path d="M 380 110 L 380 140 A 15 4 0 0 0 410 140 L 410 110" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="395" cy="110" rx="15" ry="4" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 210 120 Q 300 120 375 120" fill="none" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  <text x="385" y="100" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">Sale: 20L</text>
  <text x="415" y="130" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">@ ₹70/L</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution -->
  <text x="30" y="200" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Mean CP = (40 × 50 + 60 × 60) ÷ 100 = ₹56/L</text>
  <text x="30" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Profit on 20L = 20 × (70 − 56) = ₹280</text>
  <text x="30" y="255" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = Rs. 280 profit</text>
</svg>

cosA = 1 − 2sin2A

cos2A = 1 − 2sin2A

cos2A = cosA

questions.questionHtml: The number of triangles formed by diagonals from one vertex of an octagon is:
questions.solution:
The number of sides of the polygon = 8.

Number of triangles = n − 2.

⇒ Number of triangles = 8 − 2 = 6.

questions.question: A 5-foot person casts a 4-foot shadow. At the same time, a tree casts a 20-foot shadow. How tall is the tree?
questions.questionHtml: A 5-foot person casts a 4-foot shadow. At the same time, a tree casts a 20-foot shadow. How tall is the tree?
questions.solution:
5 ÷ 4 = Height of tree ÷ 20

Height of tree = (5 ÷ 4) × 20

Height of tree = 25
